title: GFF limits of weighted integer Lipschitz surfaces
exact_target: For the source-defined integer Lipschitz height model and each fixed $x\in [1/\operatorname{sqrt}(2),1]$, is there a positive normalization sigma(x), independent of the admissible bounded planar domain and its inside lattice approximation, such that the height distribution divided by sigma(x) converges to the domain GFF along the full mesh sequence, with every joint smooth-test moment?
